def min_added(fullsets, partsets, W):
    # total added cells per shift s (nonwrap and circular), extras ignored
    res_nw=[]; res_c=[]
    for s in range(W):
        a_nw = sum(len({x+s for x in F if x+s < W} - P) for F,P in zip(fullsets, partsets))
        a_c  = sum(len({(x+s)%W for x in F} - P) for F,P in zip(fullsets, partsets))
        res_nw.append((a_nw,s)); res_c.append((a_c,s))
    return min(res_nw), min(res_c), sorted(res_nw)[:4], sorted(res_c)[:4]

def analyze(F_, P_, bg, shp, name):
    F_, P_ = np.array(F_), np.array(P_)
    H, W = F_.shape
    print(f'--- {name} {F_.shape} bg={bg} shp={shp}')

            for r in range(H):
                for c in range(W):

                    elif c>=s: pred[r][c] = F_[r][c-s]
            mism = [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if P_[r][c]!=pred[r][c]]
            cols = sorted(set(c for _,c in mism))
            if len(mism) <= H*4:  # plausible
                print(f's={s} wrap={wrap} mismatches={len(mism)} cols={cols} rows={sorted(set(r for r,_ in mism))}')
